papers_found.title: Moira: Language-driven Hierarchical RL for Pair Trading
papers_found.summary: Hierarchical RL where LLM selects pairs (high level) and RL executes (low level). Uses prompt-updates not gradient fine-tuning. Claims consistent improvements over traditional baselines. Directly relevant to H316 STUB.

papers_found.title: Attention Factors for Statistical Arbitrage
papers_found.summary: OOS Sharpe 4.0+ gross, 2.3 net on US large-caps over 24 years. Attention mechanism learns conditional latent factors from firm characteristics. Accepted at ACM ICAIF (peer-reviewed). 'Weak factors matter when properly weighted.'

papers_found.title: LLMs for Time Series: Statistical Arbitrage Application
papers_found.summary: Chronos model on S&P500 stocks; shows LLMs can extract alpha from near-noise time series. 'Significant room for improvement.' Not production-ready but confirms directional alpha.

papers_found.title: Bridging Quantitative and Qualitative Earnings Signals (EarningsInOne)
papers_found.summary: SP1500 2005-2023 corpus. Clean temporal separation: EPS surprise dominant at announcement (gone by open), ECT management tone peaks NEXT trading day and is tradeable. Two-stage PEAD architecture directly applicable to H174 pipeline.

papers_found.title: Extracting Structure of Press Releases for Earnings Returns
papers_found.summary: 138k press releases 2005-2023. FinBERT beats bag-of-words. Soft text = as informative as EPS surprise. Markets price this at open -- limited PEAD edge from press releases alone. ECT (transcript) the better delayed signal.

papers_found.title: Stock Price Direction on Earnings Days: Multi-Modal DL
papers_found.summary: LSTM + Transformer on 15 fundamentals + 3 technicals + FinBERT news sentiment. Consistent benefit from sentiment. LSTM higher precision, Transformer higher recall on volatile moves. Focus on announcement day not drift.

papers_found.title: FinCall-Surprise: Multi-Modal Benchmark for Earnings Surprise
papers_found.summary: 2688 conference calls 2019-2021, audio+text+slides. 26 models tested. High accuracy often reflects class imbalance. Audio/visual give marginal gains. Specialist financial models struggle with instruction-following. Research benchmark, not production-ready.

papers_found.title: Discovery of a 13-Sharpe OOS Factor: Drift Regimes Unlock Hidden Cross-Sectional Predictability
papers_found.summary: S&P 500 2004-2024. OOS Sharpe 13.19, CAGR 158.6%, MaxDD -11.9%. Strategy: activate value (inverse price percentile) + reversal (neg 10d return z-score) ONLY when stock has >60% positive days in trailing 63-day window. 0.7/0.3 blend. Long-short market neutral. Walk-forward frozen parameters. 1000 randomization trials. Capacity $100-500M.
papers_found.action: H409 stub (file 1) - adapt to long-only on H198 universe

papers_found.title: ML Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading with Bias Correction
papers_found.summary: 213-factor PyTorch engine on A-shares. Key finding: non-executable prices (Chinese price limits) inflate IC by 18% -- 'mask-first' bias correction is single largest performance gain. OOS Sharpe 1.63 on real data (2022-2024). MIT license, code available. Main relevance: bias correction methodology for any factor backtest with price limits or execution constraints.

papers_found.title: Momentum-integrated Multi-task Stock Recommendation (MiM-StocR)
papers_found.summary: Chinese market (A-shares). Multi-task ranking + forecasting + momentum line indicator. Beats MTL baselines on SEE50/CSI100/CSI300. Limited relevance to US equity production pipeline.

papers_found.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: Multi-Agent LLM with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks
papers_found.summary: Japanese equities. Fine-grained task decomposition >> coarse-grained. Intermediate agent output quality is the critical driver. Market-neutral with portfolio optimization. Validates narrow-task LLM agent design (H274 3-agent PEAD).

papers_found.title: PortBench: Correlation-Aware Full-Pipeline LLM Portfolio Benchmark
papers_found.summary: 10 frontier LLMs, 6 asset classes, 10 years. 90% of model-profile combinations fail to beat equal-weight. Even good financial QA models fail in practice with catastrophic drawdowns under stress. Confirms: LLMs as signal generators (not portfolio managers).

papers_found.title: Alpha-R1: Alpha Screening with LLM Reasoning via RL
papers_found.summary: 8B param RL-trained model. Evaluates factor logic + news for regime-conditional alpha activation. CSI 300 + CSI 1000 tested. Outperforms RL baselines (A2C, PPO) on zero-shot transfer. Key idea: LLM 'reasons' about whether a factor should be active given current market context. Relevant to H406 factor timing design.

papers_found.title: QuantEvolver: RL Fine-Tuning for LLM Alpha Factor Discovery
papers_found.summary: Converts quantitative factor evaluation into policy updates. Miner LLM generates Factor DSL expressions; diversity-complementarity reward. Claims consistently higher RankIC than LLM baselines. Relevant to H406/H411 factor discovery design.
